animations.gameplay_purpose: Default neutral standing fighting-stance breathing loop.
animations.starting_pose: Default balanced elderly fighting guard facing right, bare feet grounded, fists up.
animations.ending_pose: Returns cleanly to F1 neutral fighting guard for seamless looping.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Connects seamlessly to Walk Forward, Walk Backward, Forward Dash, Backward Dash, Crouch Transition F1, and Jump Take-Off F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled forward advance while maintaining active fighting guard.
animations.starting_pose: Standing fighting guard initiating lead-foot step.
animations.ending_pose: Balanced guard stance ready to cycle seamlessly into F1 or Idle F1.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Transitions directly from and back into Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Cautious defensive backward retreat while keeping eyes and guard facing right.
animations.starting_pose: Standard fighting guard beginning rearward foot placement.
animations.ending_pose: Balanced retreating guard matching Idle F1 orientation.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Transitions cleanly from and back into Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Surprisingly quick forward burst demonstrating veteran explosiveness and footwork.
animations.starting_pose: Coiling guard preparation shifting weight forward.
animations.ending_pose: Braked, balanced upright standing fighting guard.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Triggered from Idle or Walk; recovers directly into Standing Guard (Idle F1).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Quick defensive rearward evasion while maintaining right-facing guard.
animations.starting_pose: Standing fighting guard shifting weight backward.
animations.ending_pose: Braced upright standing guard after absorbing rearward momentum.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Triggered from Idle; recovers directly into Standing Guard (Idle F1).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled lowering from standing guard into crouching defensive stance.
animations.starting_pose: Standing fighting guard with initial knee flexion.
animations.ending_pose: Stable elderly crouching defensive guard with both bare feet grounded.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: F1 connects from Idle F1; F2 connects directly into Crouch Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled low defensive breathing loop while holding crouch.
animations.ending_pose: Returns seamlessly to F1 crouching guard.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Entered from Crouch Transition F2; exits into Return to Standing F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled leg extension rising from crouch back into standing guard.
animations.starting_pose: Crouching defensive guard matching Crouch Idle.
animations.ending_pose: Full upright standing fighting stance matching Idle F1.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: F1 connects from Crouch Idle; F2 connects directly into Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Jump anticipation knee-bend followed by believable upward push-off.
animations.starting_pose: Grounded jump anticipation crouch with coiled knees and arms.
animations.ending_pose: Upward push-off with both bare feet visibly leaving the ground.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: F1 triggered from Idle/Walk; F2 connects directly into Jump Airborne F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Mid-air rising, apex, and descent posture while engine drives vertical arc.
animations.starting_pose: Rising airborne stance with lead knee raised and both feet off ground.
animations.ending_pose: Controlled descent posture preparing bare feet for ground contact.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: Entered from Jump Take-Off F2; F4 descent connects directly into Landing F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Safe knee-buffered impact absorption and recovery to neutral guard.
animations.starting_pose: Both bare feet contacting ground with controlled knee flexion.
animations.ending_pose: Balanced upright fighting guard matching Idle F1.
animations.cross_animation_transition_notes: F1 connects from Airborne F4 descent; F2 connects directly into Idle F1.
